description: Implementation of BufferGL class methods for OpenGL buffer management in ANGLE project, including buffer data operations, mapping, copying, and index range retrieval.

classes.name: BufferGL
classes.description: OpenGL buffer wrapper class implementing buffer data management, mapping, copying, and index range querying.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data with provided data, size, and usage, updating shadow copy if enabled.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data at a specified offset.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies a subset of data from a source buffer to this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the entire buffer for access, either via shadow copy or OpenGL buffer mapping.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a specific range of the buffer for access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer, writing back shadow data if used.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Computes the index range of data within the buffer for drawing.
